top_findings.title: Not-found path returns HTTP 500, not 404
top_findings.evidence: src/main/java/com/bookapi/service/ResourceNotFoundException.java:3 is a plain RuntimeException with no @ResponseStatus; no @ControllerAdvice/@ExceptionHandler in src/main. BookController.getBookById (BookController.java:60) throws it, so Spring returns 500. R4 requires '404 if absent'.
top_findings.suggestion: Add @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) to ResourceNotFoundException or a @RestControllerAdvice mapping it to 404.

top_findings.title: Three not-found tests fail (expect 404, get 500)
top_findings.evidence: BookControllerTest.testGetBookByIdNotFound:158, testUpdateBookNotFound:189, testDeleteBookNotFound:222 andExpect(status().isNotFound()) but get 500. Consistent with test_coverage=0.6667.
